data.name: Al Shaheer Corporation Limited
data.description: Al Shaheer Corporation Limited was incorporated on June 30, 2012 under the repealed Companies Ordinance, 1984. The Company is engaged in trading of different kinds of halal meat including goat, cow, chicken and fish, both for export market and local sales through chain of retail stores.
